description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Abyssal Harvester triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Abyssal Harvester by tapping it, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and create a token copy of Eternal Scourge that is a Nightmare in addition to its other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Abyssal Harvester triggers, untapping itself.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
